title: Base use-case selection and data models on priority workflows
requirements:
- State that information needs are derived from purposes, actors, workflows and decisions
- Select bounded use cases within goals
- Add forward references to 4.3.1 from 2.2.2, 3.4.5 and 3.6.1
- Reference SMART Guidelines where clinical content and point-of-care guidance are discussed
- Require a traceability chain for priority clinical content from requirement through model, binding, exchange and test
- Retitle or reword 'the most consequential decision' accordingly
- Add equity and unmet need to selection criteria
- Consider a short subsection on the governed information model before 4.3.3
